\documentclass{article}
\ifdefined\hatprobewithamsmath\usepackage{amsmath}\fi
\newcommand\hatprobe[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{$#2$}%
  \typeout{HAT #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}%
  \noindent #1: \copy0\par
}
\tracingoutput=1
\showboxbreadth=100
\showboxdepth=100
\begin{document}
\hatprobe{theta}{\hat{\theta}}
\hatprobe{theta-sub}{\hat{\theta}_1}
\hatprobe{theta-both}{\hat{\theta}^2_1}
\hatprobe{theta-inside}{\hat{\theta_1}}
\hatprobe{theta-grouped}{ {\hat{\theta}}_1 }
\hatprobe{x}{\hat{x}}
\hatprobe{f}{\hat{f}}
\hatprobe{xy}{\hat{xy}}
\hatprobe{nested}{\hat{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{grouped-x}{\hat{{x}}}
\hatprobe{script}{\scriptstyle\hat{\theta}_1}
\hatprobe{scriptscript}{\scriptscriptstyle\hat{\theta}_2}
{\footnotesize\hatprobe{eight}{\hat{\theta}_1}}
{\large\hatprobe{twelve}{\hat{\theta}_1}}
{\boldmath\hatprobe{bold}{\hat{\theta}_1}}
\hatprobe{mathbf}{\mathbf{\hat{x}}}
\hatprobe{mathbf-inside}{\hat{\mathbf{x}}}
\hatprobe{fraction}{\hat{\frac{x}{y}}}
\end{document}
